notes: Several candidates with 1-4 starts are nominal replacements despite user criterion of starter or starter-equivalent: reconsider/remove in historical review.
Barcelona 4-3-3 used as representative, Messi RW nominal despite occasional central role.
Atlético Rodri and Thomas central/DM split; Saúl and Koke wide/CM appearances require gamewise study.
Valencia Wass assigned RB where played extensively; midfield paired Parejo/Coquelin; positional-share census pending.
Getafe Bordalás two forwards Molina/Mata and Foulquier right midfield/FB split need matchwise confirmation.
Sevilla Machín used 3-5-2 with wingbacks for many rounds; 4-2-3-1 just site representation. Navas right wingback and Promes left wingback/winger shares not independently determined.
Espanyol Rubi 4-3-3 with Melendo as nominal RW, Granero CM; actual left/right role audit pending.
Golkeeper negative BDF goals represent goals conceded; goal values coded zero.
Two prior DRAFT records reused only as possible birthday convenience and older-season pointer, no independent validation.
Potential player ratings and ranks subjective provisional.
